name: Challenge Timer by OPNiki
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: OPNiki
description: A run timer above your hotbar, controlled by commands. Free hex colour, optional background, and progress saved per world. Only for Singleplayer.
works: A run timer on the HUD (above the hotbar, or at the top with /timer pos top), driven by client commands /timer start|pause|resume|reset|set|color|bg|hide|show.
